name: integral-float
note: Python writes 94.0, JS writes 94 - real, 72 times across 18 events of cases/001

name: zero-float
note: the same class, and the commonest one in a measurement payload

name: fraction
note: 4.5 happens to agree across the two, but no rule can promise that - refuse every float

name: exp-small
note: Python pads the exponent to two digits, JS does not: 1e-07 against 1e-7

name: exp-large
note: Python goes scientific from 1e16, JS only from 1e21: 1e+16 against 10000000000000000

name: big-integer
note: beyond 2^53 JS loses precision SILENTLY and returns 9007199254740992

name: non-ascii-key
note: code-point against UTF-16 key ordering; forbidden rather than specified

name: float-in-array
note: numbers inside arrays are numbers too

name: float-inside-a-string
note: MUST NOT be flagged: it is inside a string. A scanner that does not skip strings is wrong.
